decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.3.0 release execution as a Discovery Layer design milestone.
rationale: Need validation, project charter, resource claim, policy review, and role evidence all support releasing v0.3.0 only as a versioned design baseline.
recommendation: Proceed to metadata update, verification, release commit, annotated tag v0.3.0, push, and GitHub Release creation.
expected_user_reaction: They can cite v0.3.0 as the accepted Discovery Layer design boundary without assuming completed runtime implementation.
artifact_change_recommendations: Release notes must identify schemas, verifier rules, examples, and pilot evidence as future work.
organization_change_recommendations: Keep QIF standalone and position AOF as governance evidence or one consumer, not a required QIF runtime.
